_doc: FINAL consolidation of the online N-400 capture. Draft 13370795, 2026-07-30. Supersedes the STILL_OPEN lists in the earlier three files. Read order: n400-online-capture-notes.md (traps + narrative) -> n400-online-field-dump.json (unconditional pages) -> n400-online-reveals.json (in-page reveals, repeater rows) -> n400-online-committed-walk.json (committed-walk page growth, evidence slugs, upload control) -> THIS FILE (everything captured in the final sweep + what genuinely remains). Nothing was Submitted, Signed or Paid at any point; Next is refused by PATH on /review-and-submit/*.

OPTION_CODE_TABLES._warning: FOUR different code styles coexist in this one form: opaque non-sequential numerics, contiguous numerics, word codes, and full display text. Never infer a style; capture per field.

codes.189: Spouse, former spouse, or child of a U.S. citizen under the Violence Against Women Act (VAWA)
codes.193: Spouse of U.S. citizen in qualified employment outside the United States
codes.194: Military service during a period of hostilities
codes.190: At least one year of honorable military service at any time

yourFamily.maritalStatus.status.trap: Separated is 7. Code 5 is Marriage annulled. Positional guessing files the wrong status.

applicant.describeYourself.gender.note: Same pair already confirmed live on the I-130 (2026-06-26), so it is a myUSCIS-wide convention, not a one-off.

applicant.describeYourself.race_checkbox.style: BARE NUMERIC NAMES — each race is its own checkbox whose NAME is the code; there is no Formik path at all

codes.6: Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander

applicant.describeYourself.race_checkbox.trap: There is NO code 4 — the set is non-contiguous. And because the name is just '1'..'6', any selector keyed on a dotted Formik path will never find these. They need label matching.

yourFamily.children.childrenInformation..style: FULL DISPLAY TEXT as the code
yourFamily.children.childrenInformation..trap: For the third option the code ('Unknown') differs from the label ('Unknown/Missing').

codes.byBirth: By Birth in the United States

AUTOCOMPLETE_OPTION_LISTS._note: These are MUI Autocompletes: they commit on selecting a listbox option, and they filter by DISPLAY TEXT. Whatever we store must match one of these strings byte for byte — this is the exact lesson the I-539 status pickers taught. Captured live by opening each listbox.
AUTOCOMPLETE_OPTION_LISTS.watch_out: 'Blonde' not 'Blond'. 'Bald (no hair)' carries parentheses. 'Unknown/Other' carries a slash. 'Gray' not 'Grey'. Our applicant.eye_color / applicant.hair_color facts must be normalised to these exact strings or the listbox never commits.
still_uncaptured: placeOfCrimeOrOffense.country/state — all shared widgets, presumably the same lists the I-130 already uses (country_name / state_name transforms)

notes: employer and self-employment are field-for-field IDENTICAL — the type code is the only difference.
unemployment has NO address block and NO occupation. A descriptor that drives address fields for an unemployment row will report failures for fields that legitimately do not exist.
school swaps employmentInfo.* for schoolInfo.* (schoolName / fieldOfStudy).

Our fact applicant.employment_education_history[i] has one flat shape (name / occupation_or_field / from / to / city / state / country). The backend map must choose a TYPE per row and then emit the matching field names — a single static row_map cannot serve all four shapes.

/your-family/current-spouse.GOOD_NEWS: isPhysicalAddressSame here is a RADIO (true/false), unlike the applicant's own mailing control which is a checkbox. So this one CAN express 'false' — no repeat of the I-130/I-539 checkbox bug on this field.

/your-family/current-spouse/current-spou.NAMING_TRAP: currentSpouse1 vs currentSpouse2 is the PAGE number, NOT a second spouse. Page 1 fields are all currentSpouse1.*, page 2 fields are all currentSpouse2.*. Reading it as 'spouse 1 / spouse 2' would model the data completely wrong.

/moral-character/crimes-and-offenses/cri.note: Single radio. Not a repeater — no Add button.

/moral-character/oath-of-allegiance.note: Both plain true/false Yes/No. This was the last of the three originally-bouncing pages; it became reachable once upstream answers were committed.
/moral-character/oath-of-allegiance.legal_flag: unableToTakeOath=Yes is a substantive N-648-adjacent answer. It should NEVER be auto-filled from a default — only from an explicit firm answer.

/additional-information/additional-infor.IMPORTANT: The N-400 uses additionalInformationTable. The I-539 uses additionalInformationArray. The Add LABEL is identical ('Add a response') but the field prefix is NOT — assuming they matched would have produced a map that fills nothing. Checked, not assumed.
/additional-information/additional-infor.SOF_1066: section/page/question/response line up with the 'page/part/item boxes' SOF-1066 wants for PDF Part 14. This is also where the online form takes overflow text, in place of a paper continuation sheet.

REPEATER_BUTTON_MATRIX._warning: SEVEN repeaters, FIVE distinct row-commit labels, and one bare 'Add'. A single regex cannot drive these, and a loose /add/ matcher hits several at once. The I-539 already lost builds to exactly this.

GAP_CLOSURE_PASS._doc: Final sweep, same session. All three items listed as remaining were closed.

ALL_12_EVIDENCE_PAGES_VERIFIED_IDENTICAL.checked: every one of the twelve, individually — not extrapolated from a sample
ALL_12_EVIDENCE_PAGES_VERIFIED_IDENTICAL.conclusion: One uniform upload control across the whole form. The existing doc-uploader's batch-via-DataTransfer approach applies unchanged, and the descriptor can treat every /evidence/* page the same way.
ALL_12_EVIDENCE_PAGES_VERIFIED_IDENTICAL.SELECTOR_NOTE: The input has an id and NO name attribute, so any name-keyed selector misses it. Target id=desktop-drop (or the type=file input).
ALL_12_EVIDENCE_PAGES_VERIFIED_IDENTICAL.PNG_STILL_THE_RISK: No image/png in the accept list on ANY of the twelve. Refuse or convert PNGs backend-side, the way too_big_for_uscis already handles the 12MB cap.
ALL_12_EVIDENCE_PAGES_VERIFIED_IDENTICAL.CASE_TRAP_CONFIRMED: /evidence/Alternative-sentencing-or-rehabilitative-programs loaded correctly ONLY with the capital A, exactly as recorded. The spelling in these files is verified, not transcribed.

state.note: includes territories and freely-associated states, not just the 50

SHARED_AUTOCOMPLETE_LISTS.BYTE_EXACT_TRAP: The state list Title-Cases EVERY word, including short ones: 'District Of Columbia' and 'Federated States Of Micronesia' have a CAPITAL 'Of'. Standard reference data (and almost certainly our stored state names) uses 'District of Columbia' with a lower-case 'of'. An exact-match pass will MISS it. This is the same class of failure as the I-539 'CODE - Description' picker problem, and it will silently leave the state blank on any DC address.
SHARED_AUTOCOMPLETE_LISTS.action: Check what the existing state_name transform emits and add a normalisation for these, or rely on a case-insensitive match. Do not assume the I-130's transform already fits — the I-130 was never tested against a DC address either, so this may be a latent bug there too.
SHARED_AUTOCOMPLETE_LISTS.not_captured: employmentInfo.occupation and placeOfCrimeOrOffense.country/state option lists — the country/state widgets are shared so the lists above apply; occupation remains undumped.

PRIOR_MARRIAGE_QUESTION_RESOLVED.finding: The online N-400 does NOT collect prior-marriage DETAIL as typed fields anywhere.
evidence: Married path (status=2) + applicant numberOfTimesMarried=2 + spouse numberOfTimesMarried=2, all COMMITTED: no new page, no new in-page fields.
Divorced path (status=3) + numberOfTimesMarried=2, COMMITTED: no new page, no new in-page fields. The two /your-family/current-spouse pages DISAPPEARED and nothing replaced them.
PRIOR_MARRIAGE_QUESTION_RESOLVED.conclusion: Online asks only HOW MANY times you have been married, and takes prior-marriage substance as DOCUMENTS via /evidence/current-marriage-certificate-and-previous-marriage-documents.
PRIOR_MARRIAGE_QUESTION_RESOLVED.PAPER_VS_ONLINE_DIVERGENCE: The paper N-400 does carry prior-marriage fields. So this is a real capability gap: facts we hold for the PDF have nowhere to go in the online fill. That is a mapping decision, not a bug to fix in the extension.
PRIOR_MARRIAGE_QUESTION_RESOLVED.scope_of_the_test: Verified on Married and Divorced. Widowed (4), Separated (7) and Marriage annulled (5) were NOT tested — the conclusion is inference from two paths, not exhaustive.

PAGES_CAN_DISAPPEAR_TOO.finding: Switching marital status from Married to Divorced REMOVED /your-family/current-spouse and /your-family/current-spouse/current-spouse-page-2, taking the count from 52 back to 50.
PAGES_CAN_DISAPPEAR_TOO.implication: The page set is not monotonic — it grows AND shrinks with answers. A walk must tolerate a descriptor page being legitimately absent, and must not treat 'declared page never appeared' as a failure. Also: memberOfArmedForces only renders for Married, so it vanished on the Divorced path.
PAGES_CAN_DISAPPEAR_TOO.warning_for_the_guard: A coverage test asserting 'every descriptor page is reachable' would be wrong. Reachability is per-scenario.

WHAT_STILL_REMAINS: Page sets for eligibility paths never seeded: military (190/194), VAWA (189), overseas-employment spouse (193), Other (195). Count reached 52 on the spouse path; other paths will differ.

Nothing else — the unconditional shape, the reveal rules, all seven repeaters, all four employment row shapes, all twelve evidence pages and their upload control, and every multi-option code table are captured.
